style: adventurous explorer anthem, cinematic folk ballad that builds: a quiet fingerpicked acoustic guitar and a soft low string pad under the verse, piano and a slow heartbeat drum come in on the pre-chorus, then one huge bright sing-along chorus with big drums, brass, soaring strings and a choir, warm friendly adult male lead vocal, a kids' choir on the answers, and it ends on one big final chord that rings out and stops clean; hopeful, brave, wide open; clean dry studio recording, high fidelity, no tape hiss, no noise, no shaker, no tambourine, 100 BPM, 4/4, D major, banjo and fiddle join on the chorus, bluegrass warmth
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Down a long dark road with his nose to the ground,
Doug was hunting for something he never found.
Then one night in the trees by a silver stream,
He found a bear who was kinder than any dream.
So he turned right around and he never looked back,
Two best friends and a wagon on a brand new track.

[Pre-Chorus]
When the wild things call, when a little one falls,
Hear the wheels on the hill and the whistle that calls!

[Chorus]
Hank and Doug! (Hank and Doug!)
Over the hills when the wild things call!
Hank and Doug! (Hank and Doug!)
Nobody's too big and nobody's too small!
It's Hank and Doug's Wild Rescue!

[Outro]
Hank and Doug!
